categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in pet food manufacturing and brand operations. Main segments include pet chewing foods (rawhide chews and plant-based chews), nutritional meat snacks, pet dry grain and wet food, and pet health supplements. The company also operates pet product retail and service businesses through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including rawhide chew production with clean manufacturing processes, collagen fiber composite technology, animal-plant protein mixing preparation technology, pet food embossing technology, freeze-drying technology, agricultural product deep processing, and high-temperature baking technology for pet food production. The company operates electron beam irradiation sterilization lines for product safety assurance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major international pet food brand companies and retailers in developed markets (particularly in North America and Europe), as well as domestic Chinese pet owners through online and offline retail channels. The company serves both B2B customers through ODM/OBM models and B2C consumers through direct brand sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in China (headquarters in Pingyang, Zhejiang), Vietnam, New Zealand, Cambodia, and Singapore. Major markets include the United States, Europe, and China. The company has production bases in multiple countries and serves customers across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in raw material sourcing (rawhide, meat, plant starches), midstream in manufacturing and processing, and downstream in distribution and retail. The company controls the full value chain from production to direct consumer sales through owned brands and retail channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) self-owned brand development and market expansion, particularly for premium brands like Jueyuan and Haoshijia; (2) main grain product innovation including baked grain, air-dried grain, and freeze-dried grain products; (3) international expansion and multi-country manufacturing optimization; (4) product differentiation through functional and health-focused pet foods; (5) digital transformation and e-commerce channel development.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple models: (1) ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) for international customers, accounting for majority of export revenue; (2) OBM (Original Brand Manufacturing) through self-owned brands sold via e-commerce and retail channels; (3) direct sales to distributors and retailers; (4) online direct-to-consumer sales through platforms like Tmall and JD.com.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading Chinese pet food manufacturer and a global leader in pet chewing food products. Major international competitors include Mars, Nestlé, and other multinational pet food companies. Domestically, the company competes with emerging Chinese pet food brands. The company differentiates through manufacturing scale, technology innovation, and brand building capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large scale pet food manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 1.659 billion yuan, representing 17.56% growth year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 182.2 million yuan in 2024 (compared to -11.1 million yuan loss in 2023). The company shows strong recovery and growth trajectory with improving profitability and cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes: (1) high-quality, scientifically-formulated pet nutrition products; (2) advanced manufacturing technology and food safety standards meeting international requirements; (3) diverse product portfolio addressing different pet life stages and health needs; (4) premium brand positioning with focus on pet health and owner satisfaction; (5) innovation in functional pet foods and new product categories; (6) global supply chain resilience through multi-country production bases.
